description: MAML (second-order) meta-init baseline, reviewer request 1. Functional inner loop via torch.func.functional_call; backbone trained jointly with AdamW; meta-step once per epoch over all subjects. Same LOSO protocol. Runner: run_phase3.sh or run_experiment.py --condition maml.
note: meta_lr for MAML is an Adam LR on the meta-params (default 1e-3), unlike Reptile's meta_lr which is an interpolation coefficient (default 0.1).
